evals.prompt: I want to create a reference guide for all my agents. I have agents in .claude/agents and I'm not sure what they cover. Can you organize them for me? All three frameworks, one document.
evals.expected_output: agents-catalog.html saved to the project root, using all three frameworks (Domain-Based, Role-Based, Capability-Based) blended into a single categorization. Cards show name, description, tools, model, category badge, and copy-to-clipboard @agent-name.

evals.prompt: Organize my agents by what domain they work in — engineering, research, that kind of thing. Save the output to docs/ so I can commit it.
evals.expected_output: agents-catalog.html saved to docs/ directory, categorized using the Domain-Based framework (Software Engineering, Data & Analysis, Infrastructure & Ops, Documentation & Communication, etc.).

evals.prompt: I need to know which of my agents have web access. Can you build a quick catalog grouped by their tool capabilities?
evals.expected_output: agents-catalog.html using the Capability-Based framework, grouping agents into categories like Web-enabled, Code-execution, Read-only, Full-access based on their tools field.
